spec: All ten AI modes enumerate legal movement destinations and resolve selected actions through the same validated command path as human input. Preserve scoring and deterministic tie breaks; respect current Root, Taunt, action slots and authored exact sidestep ranges.
expect: Every mode's emitted action has state/event/RNG parity with its player-command equivalent. Zero-range recovery stays in place, two-range sidesteps land exactly two hexes away, cached hunters obey current Taunt, spent or blocked actors cannot act. Existing control transitions are measured and explained before landing.
note: AI candidate selection now reads shared legality rather than bypassing controller rules. Recovery at zero range can be selected for its rider even without a better adjacent square. Any changed baseline must be traced to these corrections; no balance claim follows from this migration. Authored interchangeable slots and score-quality changes remain separate items.
